subject: MarlinTech onboarding - PO allocation variance & line-item correction
messages:
From: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@marlintech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-14T16:12:00Z
Subject: New vendor onboarding - PO questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro today. We're moving through the onboarding form and saw a couple of items that look like they might block PO issuance on your side. Quick summary:

- The onboarding form you shared (we attached our completed version) has a Tax ID field that was blank — our tax ID is 12-3456789.
- When we uploaded our invoice template we noticed the provisional PO number in your portal is "TEMP-7731" but the ledger shows a different mapping (two lines consolidated into a single SKU).

Can you confirm the PO number we should reference when sending the first invoice? Also, we prefer the license vs implementation services to be on separate line items to match our internal revenue recognition. If Redwood needs a single line, tell us and we'll adapt.

Attaching the completed onboarding form and the invoice template for reference.

Thanks,
Hannah Cho
Business Ops | MarlinTech
attachments: marlin_onboard_form.pdf, invoice_template.xlsx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@marlintech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-14T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - PO questions

Hi Hannah — thanks for sending these over and for filling the form. Two quick notes while I loop procurement in:

1) Please send the signed SOW (we will need it to finalize line item descriptions).
2) We do issue a provisional PO while onboarding; final PO number assignment happens after procurement verifies tax and billing details. That provisional PO may show as TEMP-7731 in the portal for now.

Monica — can procurement confirm whether we can split the invoice into two lines for License vs Implementation? Also there is an odd mapping in the ledger where two vendor SKUs got merged (Hannah references it above). If possible, can procurement issue a provisional mapping that keeps them distinct?

Hannah — once procurement confirms, please upload the signed SOW and the corrected invoice CSV so we can validate.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@marlintech.com>
Date: 2025-06-14T18:30:00Z
Subject: RE: New vendor onboarding - PO questions

Tessa / team,

Thanks — I reviewed MarlinTech's onboarding form and the portal ledger. Summary and action items:

- Tax ID is now captured (12-3456789) — good.
- We will provisionally assign TEMP-7731 for the onboarding period. For accounting clarity we will reserve PO 77021 as the final PO once we receive the signed SOW and W9.
- The ledger consolidated the two SKUs (SKU-LIC and SKU-SVC) into one line during the import. We can split them back into two lines in our PO issuance system, but I need: 1) exact line descriptions, 2) unit prices for each line, and 3) whether MarlinTech can accept split invoicing (two invoice lines referencing the same PO).

Proposed next steps (timeline):
- Today (EOD): MarlinTech to upload signed SOW + corrected line item CSV.
- Tomorrow AM: Procurement issues provisional split lines under TEMP-7731 and reserves final PO 77021 pending W9 and SOW validation.
- Once validated: final PO 77021 will be pushed to vendor portal and accounting notified.

Ben — can you confirm we can set the portal mapping so the invoice processor won't collapse SKU-LIC and SKU-SVC? I suspect a CSV delimiter issue in the previous import.

Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@marlintech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@marlintech.com>
Date: 2025-06-15T09:02:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - PO questions

Hi Monica / Tessa — thanks for the clear plan. Attached: signed_SOW_marlin.pdf and line_items_fix.csv with separate rows for SKU-LIC and SKU-SVC and prices. We can invoice in split lines referencing the same PO; our billing team confirms they will send one invoice PDF with two line entries.

A couple of small clarifications:
- Billing email: invoices@marlintech.com (copy to accounts@marlintech.com)
- Our preferred payment terms: Net 45 (we understand Redwood standard is Net 30; happy to align if needed for first invoice)

Let us know when TEMP-7731 shows the two lines in the portal and when PO 77021 is reserved so our finance team can expect the final PO.

Thanks,
Hannah Cho
attachments: signed_SOW_marlin.pdf, line_items_fix.csv
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Cho <hannah.cho@marlintech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-15T12:20:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding - PO questions

Thanks Hannah — got the SOW and CSV. Monica confirms procurement will:

- Create provisional split lines under TEMP-7731 in the portal (visible within the hour).
- Reserve final PO 77021 pending W9 confirmation (we have your Tax ID on file).

Please submit the first invoice to invoices@redwood.com and include both line entries and reference PO 77021 in the invoice when it is received; if you need to submit earlier against TEMP-7731, include that as a temporary reference and we will remap when the final PO is issued.

Ben is fixing the import mapping to prevent merging SKUs; Ben — can you post an update here when the portal shows both lines?

Hannah — welcome aboard, and thanks for the quick turnaround on docs. I'll close this thread once final PO is pushed.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
